item.text: {"action_type":"tool","claim_id":null,"hypothesis":"待检验猜想：对所有整数n，若0≤n≤39，则n²+n+41为素数；另将n=40作为边界反例候选检查。","parent_id":null,"tool_name":"python_experiment","arguments_json":"{\"code\":\"records = []\\nfor n in range(41):\\n    value = n*n+n+41\\n    divisor = 2\\n    first_factor = None\\n    while divisor*divisor <= value:\\n        if value % divisor == 0:\\n            first_factor = divisor\\n            break\\n        divisor += 1\\n    records.append({'n': n, 'value': value, 'is_prime': first_factor is None, 'first_factor': first_factor, 'cofactor': value//first_factor if first_factor is not None else None})\\nresult = {'range': [0, 40], 'records': records, 'method': 'exact trial division through square root; awaiting independent verification'}\",\"max_operations\":50000,\"timeout_seconds\":12}","evidence_ids":["EV002"],"decision_summary":"上次运行预算耗尽且无结果；缩小至0至40，逐项记录素性与真因子候选，随后独立复核。此声明尚未验证，也不推广到无限范围。","expected_information":"取得小区间的完整实验记录，检验有限猜想并定位边界处的复合数候选。"}
